segments.text: Safety committee meeting is a joint meeting among workers representatives and company management with focus on safety issues.
segments.zh: 安全委员会会议是工人代表和公司管理层之间关注安全问题的联合会议。

segments.text: That means safety committee meeting is a meeting in which safety issues are also focused.
segments.zh: 也就是说，安全委员会会议是一个同时关注安全问题的会议。

segments.text: So in the safety committee meeting some workers and company management meet together.
segments.zh: 所以在安全委员会会议中，一些工人和公司管理层一起开会。

segments.text: So what is their ratio?
segments.zh: 那么他们的比例是多少？

segments.text: So as per factory act 1948 section 41G the participants have equal number of workers representatives and management representatives.
segments.zh: 根据《1948 年工厂法》第 41G 条，参会者中工人代表和管理层代表的人数相等。

segments.text: That means the ratio of 50-50 is in this committee meeting.
segments.zh: 也就是说，这个委员会会议中的比例是 50 比 50。

segments.text: So you have to keep this in mind.
segments.zh: 所以你要记住这一点。

segments.text: You can ask this question often.
segments.zh: 这个问题经常会被问到。
